incident_report.incident: Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly and made contact with ATOMIC BEAUTY.  From a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Hampered approaching the 1500 Metres.
No report.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Hampered approaching the 1500 Metres.

Approaching the 1500 Metres was steadied to avoid BRILLIANT FIRE (H Bentley) which shifted in when not clear.  H Bentley was reprimanded.  In this incident SPEEDY TRIDENT shifted out when being steadied, resulting in SMART BEAUTY, FAMILY FORTUNE and PERFECT PEACH being hampered when carried wider.  Raced keenly in the early stages.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Approaching the 1500 Metres was steadied when taken wider.  Raced keenly in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped on jumping.

K C Leung reported that from the outside barrier his instructions were to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MAGIC COSMOS, which finished tailed out on the second consecutive occasion, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MAGIC COSMOS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in consecutive barrier trials and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

H Bentley reported that after obtaining an on-pace position in the early stages his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight but could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing run.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of BRILLIANT FIRE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, BRILLIANT FIRE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped only fairly.  B Avdulla reported that his mount travelled satisfactorily in the early stages but he was concerned with its action when it came under pressure from the 800 Metres which resulted in him not testing the horse in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of WISEMAN, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, WISEMAN will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between YEE CHEONG RAIDER which was taken out by MAJESTIC DELIGHT and RICH HORSE which shifted in.
Blundered on jumping.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped.  Near the 900 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded by CIRCUIT VICTORY which shifted in before being corrected.
Approaching the 100 Metres was eased to avoid RICH HORSE when that runner was taken out by CIRCUIT VICTORY.

L Ferraris stated that the instructions were to settle where the horse was comfortable.  He said VERBIER jumped only fairly and settled back in the field.  He added, in his opinion, VERBIER did not appreciate the "Good to Firm” track conditions.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 200 Metres B Avdulla briefly dropped his left rein.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After travelling a short distance shifted out and bumped CROSSBORDERDUDE.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of CIRRUS SPEED.  Sent for sampling post-race.

From the outside barrier raced keenly in the early stages when being shifted across behind runners.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running and after the 350 Metres was steadied to avoid MASTER PHOENIX when that runner did not quicken.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After travelling a short distance was bumped by CALL ME SPARKLE.  On a number of occasions between the 100 Metres and the 50 Metres made contact with MALPENSA due to both runners shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

On a number of occasions between the 100 Metres and the 50 Metres made contact with CROSSBORDERDUDE due to both runners shifting ground.  J Orman reported that his mount jumped awkwardly and as a result got its head up and struck him in the face.  Trainer W Y So confirmed that Jockey Orman was given the option of taking up a forward position if his mount commenced well enough to do so.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  M F Poon reported that the connections had expected him to settle behind midfield.  He said when CIRRUS SPEED jumped well today he was able to obtain a more forward position than its previous race starts.

Noted to have blood at its mouth on arrival at the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres.  When commencing to finish the race off well became held up for clear running over the final 50 Metres behind CIRRUS SPEED and as a result was not ridden out to the finish of the event. <16/32026 Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that SEA CHARIOT was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, SEA CHARIOT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped only fairly.  Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres.  Over the final 50 Metres could not be ridden out when held up behind MALPENSA.
M Chadwick reported that the intention was to lead the event.  He said when RUBY SAILING was slow to begin it settled in a midfield position where it raced keenly.
Bumped approaching the 800 Metres.

Approaching the 800 Metres made contact with BRILLIANT WINNER when racing tight to the inside of BULLISH PRIDE.  Was left racing very wide and without cover from the 600 Metres.  H Bowman reported that his mount, which was having its first race start, raced greenly throughout the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced very wide and without cover until near the 600 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  After travelling a short distance was steadied when crowded by GET FRIENDLY which was racing tight to the inside of NYX GLUCK.  Near the 1000 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded by GET FRIENDLY which shifted in whilst racing keenly. For some distance near the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving between HAPPY BRETHREN and SO MY FOLKS.  Near the 150 Metres SO MY FOLKS shifted out slightly and made contact with MR INCREDIBLE, resulting in MR INCREDIBLE being awkwardly placed close to HAPPY BRETHREN for a short distance.  Sent for sampling post-race.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After improving to the inside of CHATER FLASH near the 400 Metres lay in and proved difficult to ride for some distance thereafter.  Sent for sampling post-race.
C Y Ho reported that from an inside barrier he was asked to hold an on-pace position.
No report.

On jumping shifted out and made contact with PHOENIX LIGHT.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. <16/32026 Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that CHATER FLASH was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, CHATER FLASH will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Jumped only fairly.  Near the 550 Metres made contact with NYX GLUCK on a number of occasions when improving to the outside of ALABAMA SONG.  As a result FLYING SNIPER became unbalanced.  Z Purton stated that his mount, which was having its first race start, raced greenly throughout the event and would derive a benefit from today’s race experience.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Bumped at the start.  Near the 150 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between ALABAMA SONG and FLYING SNIPER.  As a result PHOENIX LIGHT could not be ridden out for the remainder of the race.

Leaving the 800 Metres was bumped by GET FRIENDLY.  Near the 550 Metres was bumped on a number of occasions by FLYING SNIPER and taken wider.  H Bowman stated that the instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said when unable to cross GET FRIENDLY in the early stages he was obliged to race wide and after being contacted by FLYING SNIPER near the 550 Metres his mount finished the race off only fairly thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  Near the 800 Metres shifted out to avoid FLYING SNIPER when racing keenly.  A short distance later GET FRIENDLY was then eased when crowded between FLYING SNIPER and NYX GLUCK which improved to the outside of GET FRIENDLY.  C L Chau reported that his mount raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages and as a result did not run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Delayed the start when it proved difficult to load.  Before being allowed to race again, TOP MAESTRO will be required to perform satisfactorily in a stalls test.  Shortly after the start was crowded by SO MY FOLKS which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by SUPER LOVE which shifted out.  Between the 600 Metres and the 500 Metres was taken back through the field when SUPER LOVE gave ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Slow to begin.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Approaching the 1500 Metres was contacted by SUPER LOVE when that runner shifted out.  Bumped and taken wider approaching the 400 Metres.

When questioned regarding his mount leading H Bowman stated that the intention was to hold a handy position but not lead.  He said after his mount jumped well and he was positioned wide in the early stages he elected to allow the horse to stride forward and lead.  He said when joined by YODA’S CHOICE in the early stages he was satisfied to hold the lead as that runner did not place pressure on NEVER PETER OUT and his horse was racing in a good rhythm at that point.  He added whilst the section between the 1200 Metres and the 800 Metres was run inside of standard time he did not attempt to restrain his mount as at its most recent start the horse had not travelled well and he felt this was the best way to have it finish the race off in the Home Straight.

Near the 1400 Metres HAPPY UNIVERSE and GOOD GOOD were crowded by NIGHT PUROSANGUE (Y L Chung) which shifted in and away from YODA’S CHOICE.  Y L Chung was advised to exercise more care.  Approaching the 400 Metres made contact with BULL ATTITUDE when being shifted to the outside of ARIEL to improve.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Made contact with the right side of its starting gate on jumping.
C Y Ho reported that the intention was to hold a more forward position but after beginning only fairly and then being crowded by NEVER PETER OUT his mount settled further back than intended.
No report.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  D B McMonagle could offer no excuse for the horse’s failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Trainer C S Shum advised that he had been pleased with the horse leading into the race and could offer no explanation for its disappointing run.  The performance of FOREVER FOLKS was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, FOREVER FOLKS will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Near the 1400 Metres was crowded.  B Avdulla stated that his mount did not show its usual early pace to hold a more forward position.  He said GOOD GOOD did not travel well throughout the event and failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GOOD GOOD was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, GOOD GOOD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  The performance of PRINCE ALEX, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PRINCE ALEX will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with NEZHA.  Shifted out approaching the 1500 Metres and was bumped.  A Atzeni stated that his mount did not appreciate racing on the All Weather surface.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of SUPER LOVE, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, SUPER LOVE will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

No report.

On jumping was bumped by LOOKING BRIGHT which shifted in.  Near the 500 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied away from TOGETHER WE VALUE.  Between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.
Shifted in on jumping and was bumped.
Jumped awkwardly.
Passing the 200 Metres Z Purton dropped his left rein for a number of strides.
Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running and near the 150 Metres shifted to the outside of YOUTHFUL SPIRITS to obtain clear running.

Passing the 200 Metres WHIZZ KID, which was laying out, was steadied when crowded between TOGETHER WE VALUE and LOOKING BRIGHT (M F Poon) which shifted in and away from TURQUOISE VELOCITY.  M F Poon was advised to exercise more care.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when positioned close to LOOKING BRIGHT.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  Lay in over the final 500 Metres and near the 150 Metres was steadied when it shifted in towards THE UNIQUE STAR.  Over the concluding stages TACTICAL ACE raced tight to the outside of THE UNIQUE STAR and could not be fully ridden out to the finish of the event.
No report.
Shortly after the start was steadied to avoid WE ARE HERO which shifted out.  Near the 150 Metres was checked when disappointed for clear running between GIANT SPIRIT and WE ARE HERO.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly and then shortly after the start was bumped by THUNDER PRINCE which shifted out.  Near the 400 Metres was briefly held up for clear running behind NOVA KNIGHT before shifting to that runner’s outside to obtain clear running.  In this incident PAPAYA BROSE made contact with GREY CHARGER.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Became unbalanced when bumped near the 350 Metres.
No report.

Near the 350 Metres endeavoured to obtain a run between THUNDER PRINCE and KINGDOM OF RICHES where there was not sufficient room to do so.  When KINGDOM OF RICHES then shifted out slightly PROUD BOX was checked and made contact with THUNDER PRINCE when disappointed for this run.
Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when racing in restricted room between CALIFORNIA BAY and THUNDER PRINCE.

On jumping became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by NOVA KNIGHT which shifted out slightly.  Passing the 200 Metres was checked when crowded between THUNDER PRINCE which shifted in slightly and LIGHT YEARS GLORY (B Avdulla) which shifted out abruptly when positioned close to CALIFORNIA BAY.  Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that Jockey Avdulla had reacted in a reasonable period of time to attempt to avoid the crowding he was asked to exercise more care due to his mount being positioned close to CALIFORNIA BAY.  J Orman confirmed that from a wide barrier he was instructed to take up a forward position with the horse stepping up in distance.

M Chadwick stated that the intention was to be more forward as connections did not believe there was strong pace in the race.  He said when SUPERB GUY jumped only fairly he elected to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to avoid covering additional ground.
No report.

Y L Chung stated that his instructions were to hold a handy position.
Near the 400 Metres was hampered when bumped by PAPAYA BROSE when PAPAYA BROSE shifted to the outside of NOVA KNIGHT to improve.

Shifted out slightly on jumping and was bumped.  Approaching the 1300 Metres shifted out towards LAKESHORE HERO and became unbalanced when positioned close to that runner.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Approaching the 100 Metres was held up for clear running behind THUNDER BLAZE when that runner shifted to the inside of TELECOM FIGHTERS to secure clear running.
No report.
On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by OSI HONOUR which shifted out.
No report.
L Hewitson stated that his mount jumped only fairly and as a result settled further back in the field than he had intended.
No report.
C L Chau was fined the sum of $7,500 for returning 3 lbs overweight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Lay out on the Home Turn.  H Bowman stated that his mount settled behind midfield in the early stages.  He said due to the early and middle stages being run outside of standard time, when the pace increased from the 800 Metres, his mount found it difficult to make up ground from that position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out at the start and became unbalanced when it made contact with SKY VINO.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

Noted to have bled from its left nostril after the race.  An endoscopic examination conducted on DEVAS TWELVE confirmed the horse to have bled.  Before being allowed to race again, DEVAS TWELVE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Raced keenly in the early stages. Held up for clear running near the 300 Metres.

A Badel stated that he was given no specific instructions but when BIG RETURN commenced well and he was of the opinion the pace in the early stages was being run outside of standard time he elected to allow the horse to stride forward and lead without having to make use of his mount to do so.
R Kingscote stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but despite riding his mount along in the early stages it did not show sufficient pace to do so.

On jumping made contact with MADE FOR LIFE due to both runners shifting ground.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out to the finish when held up between BIG RETURN and AMAZING DUCK.
Near the 1000 Metres was eased when racing tight between LET’S HAVE FUN and AMAZING DUCK, both of which shifted ground slightly.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running approaching the 300 Metres.
Standing awkwardly in the starting gates and as a consequence was slow to begin.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 800 Metres was eased to avoid RUN RUN SMART which shifted in momentarily.
On jumping made contact with THE ALL ROUNDER due to both runners shifting ground.

J Orman stated that he was instructed not to lead on his mount and, in his opinion, is better suited over 1200 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
D B McMonagle could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
In the middle stages raced keenly.

K C Leung stated that his mount was disadvantaged by having to be ridden forward to cross BRIGHT DAY in the early stages and also being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Withdrawn on 14.3.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left hind) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter BRIGHT DAY.  Before being allowed to race again, TYCOON EXPRESS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, WUKONG JEWELLERY will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out abruptly shortly after the start and made contact with CORNERSTONE. After travelling a short distance rider Z Purton was obliged to reposition his right foot in his stirrup.
On jumping was bumped heavily by QUANTUM CLOUD which shifted in.  Near the 100 Metres shifted in, resulting in its rider C Y Ho having to straighten his mount.
Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters by CASA OF HONOR.  L Ferraris confirmed that from the outside barrier he was instructed to go forward.

Jumped only fairly and then shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between E HO HO which shifted out and THUNDER KIT which was taken in by QUANTUM CLOUD.  Near the 250 Metres CORNERSTONE (Y L Chung) attempted to improve into a run between HELENE SUPAFEELING and QUANTUM CLOUD where there was not sufficient room to do so.  As a result CORNERSTONE made heavy contact with HELENE SUPAFEELING when HELENE SUPAFEELING was checked when crowded between CORNERSTONE and E HO HO (A Badel) which shifted in slightly.  In this incident CORNERSTONE was then checked when disappointed for clear running between HELENE SUPAFEELING and QUANTUM CLOUD.  Y L Chung was reprimanded and advised he must ensure that there is sufficient room for him to improve into runs.  A Badel was advised to exercise more care.

Near the 800 Metres was hampered when bumped by QUANTUM CLOUD.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. K C Leung was severely reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides after the 200 Metres.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped heavily.  Near the 900 Metres was eased when SMART GOLF shifted in towards that runner.  Near the 800 Metres, when crossed by ALL OUT FOR SIX, then commenced to race keenly, shifted out and made contact with ANODE.  Noted to have sustained a laceration to the right hind leg after the race.

Shortly after the start was crowded by RED SEA which shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.  Near the 250 Metres was checked when disappointed for clear running between QUANTUM CLOUD and HELENE SUPAFEELING.
No report.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Near the 250 Metres shifted in slightly and became unbalanced when it made contact with HELENE SUPAFEELING.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with ALL OUT FOR SIX.

Shortly after the start made contact with NEW FUTURE FOLKS.  Sent for sampling post-race. A Atzeni was severely reprimanded in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion passing the 400 Metres.

When questioned Z Purton stated that from the outside barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages and it was agreed that he was to endeavour to improve to the inside on the Home Turn as he felt it had been difficult to make up ground when making a wide run.  He said the instructions to ride the horse in a conservative manner were also due to the fact that the horse had finished the race off only fairly at its last start when ridden in a forward position.  He said in accordance with those instructions from the outside barrier he shifted the horse across behind runners where it settled at the tail of the field.  He added after following SUPER UNICORN into the race he improved to the inside of that runner in accordance with the pre-race plan which resulted in him improving behind JOLTIN.  He said after obtaining clear running to the outside of JOLTIN near the 350 Metres he placed his mount under full pressure but MIGHTY MASTS raced greenly and was inclined to shift ground.  He said for this reason he was unable to use the whip on the horse as he was concerned had he done so it would have shifted additional ground and therefore he rode the horse vigorously hands and heels to the finish of the race.  Trainer W Y So confirmed the instructions issued and expressed satisfaction with the manner in which Jockey Purton had ridden the horse.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced keenly in the middle stages.
No report.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.

A Badel stated that he was instructed to go forward but to endeavour to obtain cover if possible.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to continue to allow his mount to stride forward to cross DO YOU JUST and this resulted in GHORGAN obtaining a position outside the leader RIDING TOGETHER.  He added on entering the Home Straight he felt the horse may have been galloped on and from this point onwards GHORGAN did not respond to his riding and gave ground.  He added, in his opinion, GHORGAN would be better suited by being able to be ridden with cover.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped shortly after the start.
Crowded shortly after the start.

Shortly after the start was checked when crowded between NEW FUTURE FOLKS and RIDING TOGETHER which was taken in by DO YOU JUST despite the efforts of its rider.  M F Poon reported that the intention was to be more forward but KA YING SUPERB settled back in the field after being checked at the start.

Crowded shortly after the start, was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  D B McMonagle stated that his mount was disadvantaged by being pressured in the lead by GHORGAN which resulted in it being left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a minor abrasion to its right hind leg.  The performance of RIDING TOGETHER, a last start winner, was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, RIDING TOGETHER will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.   Noted to have lost its right hind plate after the race.
No report.
